Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Hi Alice — thanks for the patience. Quick consolidated update and proposed plan: 

Summary of feasibility (ops confirmed):
- Tenant-scoped log retention: available on Redwood Private via per-tenant retention policy. We can set API access logs and request traces to 180 days for Hyperion only (no global change).
- Export & redaction: Platform Ops can produce a masked export for audit (configurable PII redaction; hashing and truncation options available).
- Impact: storage tier usage will increase; estimated incremental monthly storage delta for Hyperion is ~120GB for 180d vs 30d (ballpark). We will include cost delta in the pack.

Deliverables and timeline:
1) Evidence bundle (SIG/CAIQ slices + retention matrix + deletion runbook) — delivered as a Drive folder link and a single PDF: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdExample (ETA: 4 business days).
2) Draft attestation for the exception with scope, controls, and retention dates — attached as hyperion-retention-attestation-draft.docx (ETA: 4 business days).
3) Sample masked log export and a short tech note describing redaction approach (ETA: 7 business days).
4) Final sign-off process: Hyperion security approves draft attestation, we execute DocuSign, Ops schedules the retention change.

Attachments included here: redwood-retention-matrix.csv; draft attestation; a compact SIG evidence pack (sig-evidence-pack.pdf).

If that timeline works, we'll start internal prep today. Ben / Laura will pick up the technical artifacts.

If you'd like a 30-minute sync to walk through the export & redaction options, we can do tomorrow afternoon (PST).
